releasePlan.notes: Flag 'enable-player-login' (string, variations control + v1, project 'default'). LD context is {kind:'user', anonymous:true} with an SDK-generated per-visitor key; login only adds the 'name' attribute (key unchanged), so all metric events attribute to the bucketed context in both arms. Metrics (rework 3, metrics step): create_metric confirmed all four exist in project 'default' (idempotent already-exists, no change; list_metrics did not surface them, a listing gap). Roles: enable-player-login-error-rate = KILLSWITCH (event enable-player-login-error, both arms); enable-player-login-game-started = PAUSE (business, event enable-player-login-game-started, both arms; a drop means login causes abandonment); enable-player-login-latency = MONITORING (numeric ms, intended event enable-player-login-time-to-start, both arms; v1 is slower by design); enable-player-login-login-completed = MONITORING (v1 only, one-armed). Every event key is a literal string in invaders.html. Event-key mapping of the existing latency metric could not be read back with the available tools (create_metric does not overwrite existing definitions); a human should confirm in the LD UI that enable-player-login-latency uses event key enable-player-login-time-to-start. Global autogen metrics (ld_autogen__otel-*, ld_autogen__telemetry-*) are NOT attached: this static page loads no LD observability or OTel plugin, so those signals cannot be attributed to this flag. Changing the context key also affects 'invaders-shooter-sprite' (now bucketed per visitor).
